description: This file implements SAML2 authentication integration for SuiteCRM by defining the class SAML2Authenticate, which extends SugarAuthenticate. It contains methods for handling login via SAML2, generating metadata, and managing logout processes. It also includes a standalone function for generating SAML2 metadata XML.

classes.name: SAML2Authenticate
classes.description: Class handling SAML2 authentication within SuiteCRM, including login, logout, and session management.

methods.name: pre_login
methods.description: Handles the pre-login process, authenticating users via SAML2, processing responses, and managing session data.

methods.name: redirectToLogin
methods.description: Overrides default login redirection to support SAML2-based login based on session data.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Manages logout process using SAML2 Single Logout (SLO).

methods.name: preLogout
methods.description: Prepares for logout by storing necessary SAML2 session information before actual logout.
